verdict.rationale: The product ships its own standard-library Python check scripts, such as WCAG contrast on tokens, that run from the command line without network access, so parts of it can run unattended. The core skills, though, are invoked interactively inside Claude Code or a chat, and no headless or CI mode is documented for them. Missing for 10: a documented headless/non-interactive mode for the skill pipeline, CI integration examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), exit-code or gating semantics for the preflight/sweep, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: python3 replica-design/contrast.py replica/design/tokens.json           # WCAG contrast on your tokens
Six of them, all standard-library Python. None touch the network.
